task_description.overview: Scan all MiniSEED waveform files in a directory and apply channel-completeness-driven branching to standardize three-component seismic data (N, E, Z). The workflow routes processing based on the availability of components at each station.
steps: Scan all .mseed files in the specified directory.
Group waveform traces by station and time segment.
Check component completeness (N, E, Z) for each station group.
If N, E, and Z components exist, directly save them as standardized three-component output.
If two components exist and include Z, duplicate Z to the missing horizontal component and save standardized output.
If only Z component exists, duplicate Z to N and E components and save standardized output.
If Z component is missing or component configuration is invalid, report missing data without generating standardized output.
Save all standardized three-component waveforms into an output directory and generate a completeness report.

task_definition.agent_prompt: Scan all MiniSEED files under {data_directory}. Group waveform traces by station and time window. Check component completeness for each station-day. If three components (N, E, Z) exist, directly saved with name {waveform_data}. If two components exist and include Z, duplicate the Z component to the missing horizontal component and save with name {waveform_data}. If only Z exists, duplicate Z to N and E and save with name {waveform_data}. If Z-component is missing, ignore this station-day but record the station and time window in the completeness report. Save the completeness report to {reports_data.save_name} with content {reports_data.content}.
